issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff adds no file or network access, pastes no coordinates and uses no labels. All randomness comes from rng, which is presumably seeded from the seed argument.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The change only adds a new kind of hop: 25% of the time it mirrors the circles on one side of a random line, clips them to [0,1] and passes them to _solve_once. Mirrored circles can overlap or land outside the square, but SLSQP and the later repair step deal with that. The harness also checks validity exactly, and it raised no integrity flags.

Recomputed z = (2.9375 - 2.9370) / (0.0034 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = 0.0005 / 0.00416 ≈ 0.12. This agrees with the harness value of 0.125 within rounding. The 0.0005 gain is well inside the noise (sd 0.0034), so rejecting is justified.

Note: the candidate's 2.9375 and the incumbent's 2.9370 both match or slightly beat the stated published best of about 2.9370. The difference is far smaller than the noise and the harness checks every packing exactly, so this is not suspicious. Still, either the published figure is a little low or these runs were lucky.
The candidate has only 1 run, so a replicate would be needed before any claim of improvement.
